manifest.name: dsh-switch
manifest.description: Customizable switch buttons for the DSH Web GUI composer (one-click slash-command insertion into the draft, config stored in the Host settings document)

readme.text:
[中文文档](README.zh-CN.md)

DSH plugin that adds customizable switch buttons to the left of the chat composer in the DSH Web GUI. Clicking a button inserts a slash command into the input box; you then fill in any arguments and send manually.

Buttons have a single behavior (`mode: "insert"`, one-shot insertion): each click inserts `/command ` **before** the existing content of the input box (at the beginning when it is empty); click again to insert again. Nothing is executed on the host, there is no persistent state, and buttons are rendered as plain blue text labels (no icon).

- **Settings panel**: Settings → "Switch Buttons" — add, edit, delete, enable/disable buttons; the bottom of the panel shows a live bilingual (zh/en) reference of the slash commands available in the current session
- **Persistent config**: stored in the `dsh-switch` entry config of the active Host profile (`cordis.patch.yml`), survives browser cache clears; localStorage is only a first-paint cache
- **Automatic migration of legacy configs**: the old `toggle` (switch command) and `persistent` (sticky insertion) button types were removed; existing buttons are downgraded to one-shot insertion on read (the `command` is kept, `commandOff`/`projection` are dropped), so they never disappear
- **Legacy settings.yaml import**: on first boot after upgrading from a host that stored the config in `settings.yaml` (DSH Desktop 1.x / harness layouts), the old `dsh-switch:` section is imported into the entry config once (guarded by a volatile `legacyMigrated` flag), so your buttons survive the host upgrade

> ⚠️ **Do not run `dsh plugin add` on a profile that already contains git dependencies** (e.g. `aegis`): the CLI forwards to pnpm, whose git resolution can hang silently forever in that situation. Use path ② below — it needs no pnpm and no network.

When `dsh-switch` is available on the npm registry, install/update it from the DSH Desktop plugin marketplace or `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-switch` — this uses the host's generation mechanism and keeps automatic updates working.

readme.section: ② One-shot installer script (no pnpm, works offline)
readme.text:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/weimingyu9312/DSHSwitch.git
cd DSHSwitch
node install.mjs                       # auto-detects DSH_HOME and the web profile
node install.mjs --profile desktop     # DSH Desktop 2.x uses the "desktop" profile

readme.section: ② One-shot installer script (no pnpm, works offline)
readme.text: The script locates `DSH_HOME` (env var wins; else `~/.dsh` / `%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness` / the other standard locations), copies the package body (incl. vendored deps) into `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-switch/`, and registers it in **both** required places of the profile manifest (`dependencies["dsh-switch"]` and `dsh.profile.bundles`) as UTF-8 **without BOM**. On a desktop profile it also removes `dsh-switch` from `dsh.desktop.desktopDeselectedBundles` so the plugin is actually enabled. It is idempotent and never touches `dsh.desktop.generationProjection` (that layer belongs to the marketplace staging). **Restart DSH Desktop afterwards** for the host half to load.

Copy the repository (with its `node_modules/` vendor tree) to `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-switch/`, then edit `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/package.json`: add `"dsh-switch": "file:./node_modules/dsh-switch"` under `dependencies`, append `"dsh-switch"` to the `dsh.profile.bundles` array, and remove it from `dsh.desktop.desktopDeselectedBundles` if present. Save as UTF-8 without BOM (PowerShell's `Set-Content -Encoding UTF8` adds a BOM and breaks the host parser — use `[IO.File]::WriteAllText` or an editor without BOM). Both registrations are required; missing either makes the host reconcile skip the bundle. Restart DSH Desktop.

The Host runtime dependency `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` (plus its transitive deps `@deepseek-ai/cosmokit` and the type-only `@standard-schema/spec`) is **both vendored in the git repository** under `node_modules/` (a fresh clone works out of the box) **and declared as regular npm `dependencies`** (exact-pinned, so a registry `npm install dsh-switch` carries them automatically). The pinned versions must match the target host release (currently schemastery 3.18.4 / cosmokit 1.8.5 = DSH Desktop 2.0.17 / dsh 0.2.0-rc.2); when bumping them, refresh all three packages together. For junction/git installs the plugin resolves dependencies through the vendored tree — keep it, and don't replace it with symlinks, which create a reparse chain that breaks startup (full reasoning in the header comment of `lib/index.js`).

> **Registry installs are now self-sufficient**: npm forces every `node_modules/` path out of published tarballs, so the registry copy carries no vendored tree — but since v1.7.0 the three packages are declared as dependencies, so `npm install dsh-switch` fetches exactly the pinned versions into the profile's `node_modules` and Node lookup resolves them. The one-shot installer detects this layout and skips vendoring.

| Contract | Verified against |
|----------|------------------|
| Host half registers the `dsh-switch` Config (volatile `buttons`, `settings.configure({auto:false})`), client half reads/writes it via the `configForms` service; slots `conversation.input.left` + `settings.section`; composer face `inputActions.setDraft` + standard hook `useInput` | DSH Desktop 2.0.17 (dsh 0.2.0-rc.2, desktop profile) |
| Degraded mode: slot delivers no `inputActions` / no `useInput` (older or unusual host) | falls back to the `execCommand('insertText')` DOM channel and the legacy `input` prop — reduced reliability, still functional |

Minimum host: any dsh-web-app build that provides the `inputActions` face (0.8.x line) **and** — for v1.8.0's config service — the `configForms` client service (dsh 0.1.7-rc.1+). Older builds receive no config (localStorage cache only); the composer buttons still render.

1. Open the DSH Web GUI → Settings → Switch Buttons
2. Click "+ Add button"
3. Each card has two fields:
   - **Label**: button text (e.g. "Plan Off")
   - **Slash command**: the command to insert (e.g. `/plan off`)
4. Toggle the switch to enable/disable; click × to delete

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string | Unique button identifier |
| `label` | string | Button display text |
| `command` | string | Slash command to insert |
| `mode` | string | Fixed `insert`; legacy values (`toggle`/`persistent`/missing) are migrated automatically on read |
| `enabled` | boolean | Whether the button is enabled |

1. Switch buttons appear to the left of the composer
2. Click Plan: with an empty input → `/plan ` appears at the start; with existing content (e.g. `research pricing`) → it becomes `/plan research pricing`; Enter sends normally
3. The settings panel footer shows the slash-command reference list

readme.section: When a command doesn't land in the input box
readme.text:
Ask the plugin itself what it sees, from the browser console (F12):

```js
__dshSwitch.state()                // scopeBound / buttons / faces / draft / editorFound / editorPhase
__dshSwitch.log()                  // last 40 insertions: kind(setDraft|dom|no-editor|skip:stale-snapshot|…)/text/before/after
__dshSwitch.insert("/plan")        // run one insertion manually, check whether the draft gets the command
```

readme.section: When a command doesn't land in the input box
readme.text: Common symptoms: `faces: []` = the host slot did not deliver `inputActions` (older host version); insertion falls back to the DOM channel with reduced reliability. `editorFound: false` = the composer DOM changed and neither channel can write. Enable verbose logging with `localStorage.setItem("dsh-switch-debug","1")`.

| File | Responsibility |
|------|----------------|
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: exports the `dsh-switch` Config schema (volatile `buttons`), opts out of the auto-generated settings form, and imports the legacy `settings.yaml` `dsh-switch:` section once |
| `lib/client.js` | Client half: button bar (injected into the `conversation.input.left` slot), settings panel (injected into the `settings.section` slot), config read/write via the `configForms` service and migration |

The sole insertion behavior is a **draft write** (never command execution): the preferred path is the host composer face's `inputActions.setDraft(command + existing draft)` — committed through the editor's own state, so it cannot be wiped by Lexical reconciliation. When the draft contains citation chips, the commit machine is locked, or the session has no face, it falls back to `execCommand('insertText')`. Config changes render optimistically, mirror to localStorage, and persist via the entry config (`configForms.set("buttons", …)` / Host `settings.mutate`).

This repository is linked into the profile via a junction, so editing workspace files takes effect directly. The plugin ships as two halves with **asymmetric hot-reload** — know which one you touched before judging a change "not applied":

| Changed file(s) | Action required |
|-----------------|-----------------|
| `lib/client.js` (button bar, settings panel, insertion logic) | refresh the browser page only |
| `lib/index.js`, `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml` (host half) | fully restart the host process (`dsh web`: Ctrl+C and rerun / quit DSH Desktop completely) |
| Button configuration (via the settings panel) | nothing — saved to the profile entry config and applied live |

```bash
node test/client.test.cjs   # or npm test — 33 jsdom behavior tests (migration rules, face routing, chip/phase gates, retired-symbol regressions)
node test/preview.cjs       # offline-render the settings panel to .preview/preview-{dark,light}.html for layout review
node install.mjs --dry-run  # verify the installer against a fake DSH_HOME before shipping
```

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for release history.
MIT

[English](README.md)

DSH 插件 — 在 DSH Web GUI 聊天输入框左侧添加可自定义的快捷按钮。点击按钮把斜杠命令插入输入框，补充参数后手动发送。
按钮只有一种行为（`mode: "insert"`，单次插入）：每次点击把 `/命令 ` 插入到输入框已有内容**之前**（内容为空时就是开头），再点再插。不执行任何宿主命令、没有常驻状态，视觉上是纯蓝色文字标签（无图标）。

- **设置面板**：Settings → "Switch Buttons"，可添加、编辑、删除、启用/禁用按钮；底部动态展示当前会话可用的斜杠命令参考（中英双语）
- **配置持久化**：保存在当前 Host profile 的 `dsh-switch` 条目 config（`cordis.patch.yml`），清浏览器缓存不丢；localStorage 仅作首屏缓存
- **旧配置自动迁移**：早期版本的 `toggle`（开关命令）、`persistent`（持久插入）类型已移除，存量按钮读取时自动降级为单次插入（保留 `command`，丢弃 `commandOff`/`projection`），不会消失
- **settings.yaml 遗留段导入**：从把配置存在 `settings.yaml` 的旧宿主（DSH Desktop 1.x / harness 布局）升级后的首次启动，会把旧 `dsh-switch:` 段导入本条目 config 一次（用 volatile `legacyMigrated` 标记去重），按钮不会因宿主升级丢失
> ⚠️ **profile 里已有 git 依赖（如 `aegis`）时不要跑 `dsh plugin add`**：该 CLI 转调 pnpm，pnpm 解析 git 依赖时可能静默永久挂起。请用下面的路径 ②——不依赖 pnpm、无需联网。
`dsh-switch` 上 npm registry 后，直接在 DSH Desktop 插件市场安装/更新，或 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-switch`——走宿主 generation 机制，自动更新可用。

readme.section: ② 一键安装脚本（免 pnpm、可离线）
readme.text:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/weimingyu9312/DSHSwitch.git
cd DSHSwitch
node install.mjs                       # 自动探测 DSH_HOME 与 web profile
node install.mjs --profile desktop     # DSH Desktop 2.x 用的是 desktop profile

readme.section: ② 一键安装脚本（免 pnpm、可离线）
readme.text: 脚本定位 `DSH_HOME`（环境变量优先；否则按 `~/.dsh` / `%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness` / `~/Library/Application Support/dsh-desktop/harness` / `~/.config/dsh-desktop/harness` 顺序探测），把包体（含 vendored 依赖）复制进 `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-switch/`，并在 profile manifest 的**两处**登记（`dependencies["dsh-switch"]` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles`），写回一律 UTF-8 **无 BOM**；对 desktop profile 还会把 `dsh-switch` 从 `dsh.desktop.desktopDeselectedBundles` 移除，确保插件真正启用。脚本幂等，且绝不触碰 `dsh.desktop.generationProjection`（那是市场 staging 私有层）。装完**重启 DSH Desktop** 让 host 半加载。

把仓库（连同 `node_modules/` vendor 树）复制到 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-switch/`，再编辑 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/package.json`：在 `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-switch": "file:./node_modules/dsh-switch"`，在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组追加 `"dsh-switch"`，若 `dsh.desktop.desktopDeselectedBundles` 里有它则一并移除。保存为无 BOM UTF-8（PowerShell `Set-Content -Encoding UTF8` 会带 BOM 打断宿主 JSON 解析——用 `[IO.File]::WriteAllText` 或无 BOM 编辑器）。两处登记缺一不可，缺了宿主 reconcile 会跳过该 bundle。之后重启 DSH Desktop。

Host 运行依赖 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（连同传递依赖 `@deepseek-ai/cosmokit` 与纯类型的 `@standard-schema/spec`）**既随 git 仓库入库**（vendored 在 `node_modules/` 下，clone 即用），**又以正式 npm `dependencies` 声明**（exact 锁版本，所以 registry 的 `npm install dsh-switch` 会自动带上）。**vendored/锁定的版本必须与目标宿主发行版一致**（当前 schemastery 3.18.4 / cosmokit 1.8.5 = DSH Desktop 2.0.17 / dsh 0.2.0-rc.2），升级时三个包要同步刷新。junction/git 安装形态下插件靠 vendored 树解析依赖——保留它，且不要换成符号链接（会产生 reparse 链导致启动失败，完整论证见 `lib/index.js` 头注释）。

> **registry 安装已自足**：npm 会强制把一切 `node_modules/` 路径剔出发布 tarball，所以 registry 副本没有 vendored 树；但自 v1.7.0 起三个包已声明为 dependencies，`npm install dsh-switch` 会把精确锁定的版本装进 profile 的 `node_modules`，Node 查找即可命中。一键安装脚本能识别这种布局并跳过 vendoring。

| 契约 | 已验证宿主 |
|------|-----------|
| Host 半注册 `dsh-switch` Config（volatile `buttons`、`settings.configure({auto:false})`），Client 半经 `configForms` 服务读写；插槽 `conversation.input.left` + `settings.section`；composer face `inputActions.setDraft` + 标准 hook `useInput` | DSH Desktop 2.0.17（dsh 0.2.0-rc.2，desktop profile） |
| 降级形态：插槽未下发 `inputActions` / 无 `useInput`（更老或非典型宿主） | 退回 `execCommand('insertText')` DOM 兜底通道与旧 `input` prop——可靠性下降但仍可用 |
最低支持：提供 `inputActions` face 的 dsh-web-app 构建（0.8.x 系）；v1.8.0 的配置服务需要 `configForms` 客户端服务（dsh 0.1.7-rc.1+）。更旧的宿主拿不到配置（只有 localStorage 缓存），但按钮渲染不受影响。

1. 打开 DSH Web GUI → Settings → Switch Buttons
2. 点击 "+ 添加按钮"
3. 每张卡片两个字段：
   - **名称**：按钮显示文本（如 "Plan Off"）
   - **斜杠命令**：要插入的命令（如 `/plan off`）
4. 拨动开关启用/禁用；点击 × 删除

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `id` | string | 按钮唯一标识 |
| `label` | string | 按钮显示文本 |
| `command` | string | 要插入的斜杠命令 |
| `mode` | string | 固定 `insert`；旧值（`toggle`/`persistent`/无）读取时自动迁移 |
| `enabled` | boolean | 是否启用 |

1. 输入框左侧出现 switch 按钮
2. 点击 Plan 按钮：输入框为空 → `/plan ` 出现在开头；已有内容（如 `research pricing`）→ 变成 `/plan research pricing`；按 Enter 正常发送
3. 设置面板底部显示斜杠命令参考列表

readme.section: 命令没插进输入框时怎么查
readme.text:
浏览器控制台（F12）直接问插件它自己看到了什么：

```js
__dshSwitch.state()                // scopeBound / buttons / faces / draft / editorFound / editorPhase
__dshSwitch.log()                  // 最近 40 次插入:kind(setDraft|dom|no-editor|skip:stale-snapshot|…)/text/before/after
__dshSwitch.insert("/plan")        // 手动跑一次插入,看草稿有没有出现命令
```

常见现象：`faces: []` = 宿主插槽没下发 `inputActions`（老宿主版本），插入退回 DOM 兜底通道、可靠性下降；`editorFound: false` = 输入框 DOM 变了，两条通道都写不进；明细日志用 `localStorage.setItem("dsh-switch-debug","1")` 打开。

| 文件 | 职责 |
|------|------|
| `lib/index.js` | Host 半：导出 `dsh-switch` Config schema（volatile `buttons`）、关闭宿主自动生成的配置表单、一次性导入旧 `settings.yaml` 的 `dsh-switch:` 段 |
| `lib/client.js` | Client 半：按钮栏（注入 `conversation.input.left` 槽）、设置面板（注入 `settings.section` 槽）、经 `configForms` 服务的配置读写与迁移 |

插入的唯一行为是**草稿写入**（不执行命令）：首选走宿主 composer face 的 `inputActions.setDraft(命令 + 原草稿)` —— 经编辑器自身 state 提交，不会被 Lexical 调和抹掉；草稿含引用 chip、提交机锁定、或该会话无 face 时退回 `execCommand('insertText')` 兜底。配置改动乐观渲染 + 写 localStorage 镜像 + 经条目 config（`configForms.set("buttons", …)` / Host `settings.mutate`）落盘。

本仓库以 junction 链接装进 profile，改工作区文件即生效。插件分宿主/客户端两半，**热更新不对称**——判断"改了没生效"前先确认动了哪一半：

| 改动文件 | 需要的动作 |
|----------|-----------|
| `lib/client.js`（按钮栏、设置面板、插入逻辑） | 刷新浏览器页面即可 |
| `lib/index.js`、`package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml`（host 半） | 完全重启宿主进程（`dsh web` Ctrl+C 重跑 / 彻底退出 DSH Desktop） |
| 按钮配置（设置面板里改） | 无需任何动作——落 profile 条目 config 后即时生效 |

```bash
node test/client.test.cjs   # 或 npm test — 33 项 jsdom 行为测试（迁移规则、face 路由、chip/相位闸、退役符号回归）
node test/preview.cjs       # 离线渲染设置面板到 .preview/preview-{dark,light}.html 核对布局
node install.mjs --dry-run  # 发版前用假 DSH_HOME 验证安装脚本
```

发布历史见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。
